Name: Ophel
Description: The steep hill in Jerusalem south of the temple, built up by Jotham, walled by Manasseh, repaired by the Nethinim under Nehemiah, and lived in by the temple servants after the return.
BiblicalSignificance: Ophel is Jerusalem's working hill: fortified by kings, repaired by servants, and lived in by the men who kept the temple running.
RelatedPeople: Jotham, King of Judah; Manasseh, King of Judah; Nehemiah
